      "snippet": "Good question. Browser extensions sit between OpenAI’s native memory and your GitHub LTM—and they are useful only if you are very clear about what role they play.

Here’s the clean, non-confused model.

What browser extensions actually are (functionally)

Browser extensions for ChatGPT (memory tools, exporters, sidebars, auto-prompters, etc.) are client-side instrumentation, not memory systems.

They can:

observe

copy

re-inject

annotate

replay

They cannot:

guarantee persistence

enforce i"
